strategies.name: Concatenated Multi-Iteration Payload Bundling

Reduces dispatch count to 2-4 collectives but increases per-dispatch payload size by 2-4x and requires careful buffering of intermediate states.

strategies.name: Pipelined Dual-Stream Overlap
strategies.desc: Splits the 16384 elements into two independent halves, launches all-reduce for first half while computing local ops for second half, alternating to hide compute-communication latency. Still 8 logical iterations but doubles dispatch count to 16 (two streams) while halving per-dispatch payload; exploits parallelism if backend supports concurrent small collectives.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Phase Node-Local Reduction
strategies.desc:
Leverages multi-node topology (assumes ranks grouped into nodes): first performs intra-node reductions via device-local all-reduce primitives on subgroups, then inter-node all-reduce on node representatives, finally intra-node broadcast. Each of 8 iterations becomes 3 dispatches but with smaller effective world sizes (node-local W_local << 224), improving algorithmic latency at cost of dispatch count (24 total).
